facts: All 5 Pertinent are signals in B′ pass 2, in dev-core; none in B′ pass 1 (192 signals: S-PORTEE-FLOUE is the most frequent code there) and none among the 120 PVs.

Guide G0 requires positive evidence of the three criteria for a P code and sends an unreadable scope or direction to an S code (asymmetry reserve); the served signal text rarely states scope, direction and capacity together.
The dev pool excludes the 67 exposed cities; its P base rate is unknown (source-gap) and cannot be compared with Steve’s pass shares.
lowPertinent.consequenceForL4: With 5 Pertinent in dev-core, "Pertinent masked" on dev cannot separate prompts: 0 masked out of 5 gives a 95 % Clopper-Pearson upper bound of about 52 %, and one masked item moves the rate by 20 points. The first criterion of the lexicographic dev objective would be decided by noise; precision on P∪S and the later criteria would decide in practice. The S113 evaluation (Steve’s labels, about 38 P) is unaffected.
